items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Well, there was a piano player from here, his name was Calvin Distance. He's dead. He was killed in St. Louis. I don't think he made any name here.

ctx.x: Anybody else from here, if you remember?
